build_flash_attn2_backend: build a FlashAttention2Backend instance to use flash attention v2 as the attention backend for sglang
create_flash_attn2_impl: create a FlashAttention2Impl with num_heads, head_size, causal flag, and softmax_scale for attention computation
get_supported_head_sizes: get the list of supported head sizes (32, 64, 96, 128, 160, 192, 224, 256) from FlashAttention2Backend
get_flash_attn2_enum: get the AttentionBackendEnum value for FlashAttention2Backend to identify the backend type
run_flash_attn2_forward: run the forward pass of FlashAttention2Impl with query, key, value tensors and attention metadata
